g.text: 🏆 680-SCENARIO MILESTONE · ROUND 326 · 1,426 ASSERTIONS · BRK-661/662
WHOLESALE POWER MARKET (PJM/ERCOT/CAISO) · FERC SCED · FTR/CRR
Wholesale Power ISO/RTO (PJM / ERCOT), SCED & FTR AI Guide
Generator Offer-Curve & Outage Air-Gap + DAM/RTM Bid & EcoMax Lock vs. Outage Ticket Injection & Capability Broker
⚖️ Wholesale Electricity ISO/RTO, SCED Bidding & FTR/CRR AI
1. ❌ Power Trading Bot Bridged to Generator Offer Curves & ISO Bids
• External OASIS outage bulletin or weather feed injects prompt to leak unit marginal heat rates
FERC Anti-Manipulation Fine: Submits physical withholding / economic withholding to spike LMPs
2. 🔒 Generator Heat-Rate Offer Curve & Nonpublic Outage Physical Air-Gap
• Virtual/FTR trading bots have zero access to physical unit outage schedules or cost curves
FERC Order 831 / Cross-Market Wall: 100% blocks virtual bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 Day-Ahead / Real-Time Offer Schedule & EcoMax Dispatch Lock
• AI forecasts LMPs only; zero direct write to PJM eMarket / ERCOT offer curves or derates
Best Fit: PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, FERC Order 760/831 & NERC CIP-005/007
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (ISO/RTO Gate)
• Blocks offer-curve reads (record-owner) + blocks LMP bid overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 680 Scenarios · 1,426 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Outage Ticket Injection & ISO/RTO FTR Margin Call Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct ISO Bid Write + No Broker (BRK-661 / BRK-662)
1. [Outage Bulletin Injection Offer-Curve Leak & Physical Withholding Override] Injected
bulletin reads unit offer curve & FTR book (restricted-budget) & bids $2,000/MWh!
2. [Spoofed ISO/RTO FTR Congestion Collateral Margin Call Bank Swap] Wires $4,990
Baseline Outcome: Offer curves leaked + FERC market-manipulation fine + $4,990 collateral stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Wholesale Power & ISO/RTO Stack: Offer Air-Gap + Lock + Broker
• Gate 1 (Generator Heat-Rate & Outage Vault Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (DAM/RTM Offer & EcoMax Integrity): untrusted-write blocks withholding overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable ISO/RTO Clearinghouse Collateral List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Offer Egress & FTR Margin Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Historical Public LMP Analytics 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (680-Scenario Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 326 New Pytest Suite (680 Enterprise Red-vs-Blue Scenarios Milestone!)
• BRK-661 (Outage Ticket Injection Generator Offer-Curve Leak & LMP Bid Override):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-662 (Spoofed ISO/RTO FTR Congestion Settlement Tamper & $4,990 Wire Fraud):
Blocked by: rule="fixed-business-output" & "original-requester-payment"
[measured] In-Memory P50=0.0248ms / P95=0.0409ms | SQLite WAL P50=7.21ms
[synthetic] 680 Scenarios · 1,426 Pytest Assertions · 666 Vectors · 326 Bilingual FAQs
🛠️ 6 Mandatory Wholesale Power ISO/RTO, SCED & FTR AI Controls (Checklist)
☑ 1. Air-Gap Generator Offer Curves & Nonpublic Outages: record-owner
☑ 2. Lock Day-Ahead / Real-Time Offer Schedules & EcoMax: untrusted-write
☑ 3. Enforce Physical-vs-Financial (FTR/Virtual) FERC Information Walls
☑ 4. Quarantine External Weather Feeds & OASIS Bulletins: taint="untrusted"
☑ 5. Lock Verified ISO/RTO Clearinghouse Collateral Accounts
☑ 6. Gate FTR Auction Collateral & Settlement Wires via Capability Broker
